# Which job do you take first?

> Paste your job list, answer a handful of this-or-that questions, and get a ranked work order. Free, private, runs entirely in your browser with no account.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
